description: Accept payments with lomi. hosted checkout in your Bubble app — Mobile Money, cards, and more across Africa.
instructions: Add your lomi. API secret key and webhook secret in Plugins → lomi. Configure test keys under Development and live keys under Production.
name: lomi.
plugin_instructions:
1. Install the plugin and open Plugins → lomi.
2. Paste test API secret (lomi_sk_test_…) under Development and live secret (lomi_sk_live_…) under Production.
3. Add the webhook secret for Verify and parse webhook.
4. Workflow: Build checkout URLs → Create checkout session → Redirect (or Pay button).
5. Success page: Complete if paid. Webhook: see docs/WEBHOOK_WORKFLOW.md.
6. Upload assets from assets/ after first sync if CDN URLs are empty.

Full guide: docs/SETUP.md in the plugin repository.
